Summary
If you configure and assign a Direct Routing online voice-routing policy to the user, Teams checks the userΓÇÖs outgoing calls against the Direct Routing online voice-routing policy to determine whether their dialed number matches a number-pattern that you've defined in the online voice-routing policy.

Use the Get-CsTenantDialPlan cmdlet to retrieve a tenant dial plan.
